description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): call envelopes with published_at after the given ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (v1 basis: published_at). Use calls_list instead when you need state/asset filters rather than a time window. The comparison is strict — only envelopes published after the timestamp are returned — and v1 covers publication times only, not later grade changes. Returns {format, since, basis, count, calls}; if the store file is absent on this deployment, count 0 with a note. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).
name: calls_since
title: Calls Since Timestamp (Machine Format)
